verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim offers strong programmatic surfaces: pip-installable Python packages for composing the app (docs-12), ROS 2 services and actions to load worlds, spawn entities and step simulations (docs-4), headless operation for Isaac Lab (docs-10), and full extensibility (docs-16). However, nothing in the evidence states that every UI action has an API equivalent. The OpenAPI 404 probes are not a contradiction, since this is a Python/ROS SDK rather than a REST service. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or documentation of UI-to-API parity, API reference coverage of GUI workflows such as asset import and robot tuning, and independent hands-on confirmation of full scriptability.
